capabilities: Classify notes with the 8 Portent types or custom types via a type frontmatter field
Connect entries with Belongs To and Related To wikilink chips
Track progress states from Raw through Planning to Organized
Filter, group, and sort entries in dashboard tabs
Archive processed entries without deleting them
disambiguation: Does not move or reorganize files in folders; it tracks triage state via frontmatter fields on notes where they already are.
extras: README includes a privacy note stating the plugin reads only file paths and frontmatter, never note body content, and sends no data outside the vault.
problem: Web clips, saved articles, and research notes pile up unclassified and untracked, with no single view showing what has been dealt with and what still needs attention.

relations.evidence: enhanced with the QuickClip Capture browser extension for Chrome
compatibility with OKF (Open Knowledge Format) by Google

requires.name: QuickClip Capture browser extension for Chrome

summary: Frontmatter-driven dashboard that triages captured notes through a classify, connect, and track lifecycle until they are organized.
